question: What was the vote percentage and number of seats secured by the winning party in the 2024 Haryana Legislative Assembly elections?
solution:
The correct answer is __**39.94% votes, 48 seats**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In the 2024 Haryana Legislative Assembly elections, the winning party secured **39.94% of the total vote share**, establishing its majority.
 
• With this vote percentage, the party successfully won **48 seats** in the 90-member Haryana Legislative Assembly.
 
• The winning party's performance indicated a significant consolidation of votes in key constituencies across the state.
 
• The election results reflected the impact of strategic campaigning and voter alignment with the party’s policies.
 
• These elections were marked by competitive dynamics between major political parties, with the winning party demonstrating effective outreach efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Haryana Legislative Assembly:**

 
 
• The Haryana Legislative Assembly consists of **90 seats**, and elections are held every five years.
 
• It operates under the framework of the Indian Constitution to legislate on state-level issues.
 
• Members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs) are elected directly by the people of Haryana.
 
 
 
• **Vote Percentage and Seat Allocation:**
 
 
• Vote percentage refers to the proportion of total votes a party secures relative to all votes cast.
 
• Seats are allocated based on the number of constituencies a party wins through a simple majority system.
 
 
 
• **Electoral Process in Haryana:**
 
 
• Elections in Haryana are conducted by the **Election Commission of India**.
 
• The process includes voter registration, polling, counting of votes, and declaration of results.
 
• Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) are commonly used for voting in the state.
 
 
 
• **Major Political Parties in Haryana:**
 
 
• Key political players in Haryana include the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), Indian National Congress (INC), and regional parties like the Jannayak Janta Party (JJP).
 
• Coalitions and alliances often play a crucial role in determining electoral outcomes.
